hints.title: Modulo Invariance
hints.text: Adding or subtracting value repeatedly preserves each element modulo value.

hints.title: Remainder Frequency Grouping
hints.text: Count the frequency of each remainder (x % value + value) % value across all numbers.

hints.title: Greedy Non-Negative Generation
hints.text: To form 0, 1, 2, ..., inspect whether the corresponding remainder is available. The first integer x whose remainder count is 0 is the smallest missing value.

hints.title: Remainder Capacity Consumption Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def findSmallestInteger(self, nums: list[int], value: int) -> int:
        from collections import Counter
        count = Counter((x % value) for x in nums)
        mex = 0
        while count[mex % value] > 0:
            count[mex % value] -= 1
            mex += 1
        return mex
```

complexity.notes: Single pass to compute remainder frequencies followed by at most n + 1 increments.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all operations explicitly leads to unbounded search.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Groups by remainder modulo value and iterates until a remainder is exhausted.
